svg.title: Blue Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Observed four-sided shaped canvas; outline approximate. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of blue; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
